workflow_details.description: Add information that will help to differentiate this workflow from another.
workflow_details.title: Workflow Details

data_source.description: Select one of your configured data sources.

time_range.description: Choose the period of time to analyze.
time_range.title: Time Range

subject_group_name.description: ⚠️ The use of a group with mixed subtypes could lead to unexpected results
subject_group_name.title: Subject Group Name

trajectory_segment_filter.description: Filter track data by setting limits on track segment length, duration, and speed. Segments outside these bounds are removed, reducing noise and to focus on meaningful movement patterns.

trajectory_segment_filter_overrides.description: Use a different segment filter for specific values, e.g. a subject subtype or patrol type. Values without an override use the filter above. Leave empty unless the workflow supports per-type filtering.
trajectory_segment_filter_overrides.title: Filter Overrides

exaggeration.description: Vertical exaggeration factor. 1.0 = true scale, 2.0 = 2x heights.
exaggeration.title: Exaggeration

altitude.description: Where the tracks are drawn: on the 3D terrain as drawn on the map (the default), on the ground from elevation data, a set height above it, or at each fix's recorded altitude.
altitude.title: Track height

texture.description: URL template for tiles draped over the terrain.
texture.title: Texture

labels.description: Show place names and boundaries over the basemap, draped on the terrain (Esri World Boundaries and Places).
labels.title: Place names

pitch.description: Tilt of the map in degrees. 0 looks straight down; higher values tilt the view towards the horizon.
pitch.title: Pitch

bearing.description: Rotation of the map in degrees clockwise from north. 0 keeps north at the top; negative values rotate counter-clockwise.
bearing.title: Bearing

head.description: Marker drawn at each subject's current position: a flat dot or a 3D animal.
head.title: Marker icon

position.description: Where the bar sits on the map.
position.title: Position

show_camera.description: Camera button: design and preview the video camera, then copy its settings into render_animation.
show_camera.title: Show Camera

duration.description: Playback length in seconds (e.g. 30 = the whole timeline plays in 30 seconds). At most 600 seconds (10 minutes), the longest video that can be recorded.
duration.title: Duration

camera_settings.description: Camera for the video and the map's camera preview: Fixed view, Fly to & around, Follow a subject, Subject tour, Follow the action, Cinematic fly-through or Keyframes, or the settings of a camera designed in the map's Camera panel.
camera_settings.title: Camera

enabled.description: Render the animated map as a video file. When off, the video creation step is skipped entirely.
enabled.title: Enabled

duration.description: Video duration. 'auto' uses the animation's own playback length (duration).
duration.title: Duration

resolution.description: Output video resolution: a landscape preset (720p/1080p/4K), vertical 9:16 or square 1:1 for social media, or 'custom' width/height.
resolution.title: Resolution

overlays.description: What the video shows over the map: the date and time, legend, north arrow, scale bar, title and marker labels.
overlays.title: Overlays

AbsoluteAltitude.description:
Each fix's recorded altitude above sea level (Google's ABSOLUTE). Fixes without one, as is usual for
EarthRanger data, are drawn a set height above the ground instead of at sea level.

fallback_height.description: Metres above the ground for fixes that have no recorded altitude.
fallback_height.title: Height without an altitude (m)

AbsoluteAltitude.title: Recorded altitude (where available)

ClampToGround.description: On the ground: tracks follow the terrain; recorded altitudes are ignored (Google's CLAMP_TO_GROUND).
ClampToGround.title: On the ground

RelativeToGround.description: A set height above the ground, measured from elevation data (Google's RELATIVE_TO_GROUND).

height.description: Metres above the ground the tracks are drawn at.
height.title: Height (m)

RelativeToGround.title: Above the ground

RelativeToMesh.description:
On the 3D terrain as drawn on the map (Google's RELATIVE_TO_MESH): tracks lie on the rendered surface,
rising and falling with it at every zoom, and 3D animals stand on it. The default: nothing floats.

height.description: Metres above the drawn terrain: about 1 m lies on the ground; more lifts the line clear of it.
height.title: Height (m)

RelativeToMesh.title: On the 3D terrain

DotMarker.description:
Flat circle at each subject's current position (deck.gl ScatterplotLayer), filled
with that subject's track colour.

Field names mirror PointLayerStyle. Colours are constants rather than column accessors
because the marker's data is rebuilt in the browser every frame.

radius_units.description: Units of the radius: 'pixels' (the same size at every zoom) or 'meters' (a real size on the ground).
radius_units.title: Radius Units

stroked.description: Draw an outline around the dot.
stroked.title: Stroked

get_line_color.description: Outline colour as red, green, blue (0-255). Default white.
get_line_color.title: Get Line Color

get_line_width.description: Outline width, in `line_width_units` (pixels by default). 0 = no outline.
get_line_width.title: Get Line Width

line_width_units.description: Units of the outline width: 'pixels' (the same size at every zoom) or 'meters' (a real size on the ground).
line_width_units.title: Line Width Units

DotMarker.title: Dot

ModelMarker.description:
A ready-tuned 3D animal model: pick the animal, everything else is preset.

Drawn as a ScenegraphLayerDefinition (to_model) with the animal's tuned orientation and size.

size.description: Multiplier on the animal's real size (1 = life size, 2 = twice as big). Zoomed out it is still drawn at least 30 px tall, so it stays visible.
size.title: Size

ModelMarker.title: 3D model

CameraFromSettings.description: The camera designed in the animated map's Camera panel.

settings.description: Paste the settings copied from the Camera panel, or give the path of the downloaded settings file (.json).
settings.title: Camera settings

CameraFromSettings.title: From Camera panel settings

CameraKeyframe.description:
One waypoint on a keyframes camera path.

Only ``lon``/``lat`` are required. ``t`` places the keyframe on the clip timeline (0 = first
captured frame, 1 = last); when omitted on every keyframe they are spaced evenly.
``zoom``/``pitch``/``bearing`` left as None are interpolated between the nearest keyframes that
define them, or fall back to the whole-scene framing (zoom) and the map's pitch/bearing.

lon.description: Longitude of the camera look-at point.
lon.title: Lon

lat.description: Latitude of the camera look-at point.
lat.title: Lat

t.description: Position on the clip timeline (0 = start, 1 = end). Any increasing numbers work (they are normalized to 0–1); leave blank on every keyframe to space them evenly.
t.title: T

zoom.description: Zoom level at this keyframe. Leave blank to blend from neighbouring keyframes, or fit the whole scene if none set it.
zoom.title: Zoom

pitch.description: Camera tilt in degrees at this keyframe. Leave blank to blend from neighbouring keyframes, or use the map's tilt if none set it.
pitch.title: Pitch

bearing.description: Camera heading in degrees at this keyframe. Leave blank to blend from neighbouring keyframes, or use the map's heading if none set it.
bearing.title: Bearing

CameraKeyframe.title: CameraKeyframe

CinematicCamera.description:
Opens on the whole scene, flies in to the action, then follows it with a tilted camera that turns
slowly.

subjects.description: Only frame these subjects (their value in any column, e.g. names). Leave blank for everything that animates.
subjects.title: Subjects

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees. Leave blank for the map's.
heading.title: Heading

bearing_mode.description: 'rotate' turns steadily by `rotation` over the clip, 'heading' faces the direction of travel, 'fixed' keeps the heading.
bearing_mode.title: Turning

rotation.description: Total turn over the clip for 'rotate', in degrees.
rotation.title: Turn (°)

intro_frac.description: Share of the clip spent flying in from the whole-scene view. 0 = start on the action.
intro_frac.title: Fly-in

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

lead_room.description: Space left ahead of moving subjects, as a share of the view: the camera looks a little ahead, so they sit behind the centre with room to move into. 0 = centred.
lead_room.title: Lead room

speed_zoom.description: Zoom in (up to a level) while subjects rest or move slowly, and pull back while they travel fast. 0 = off, 1 = strongest.
speed_zoom.title: Zoom with the action

keep_in_view.description: Raise the camera when a ridge would hide what it follows, easing back down after it.
keep_in_view.title: Keep in view over hills

lead_frac.description: Look ahead by this share of the timeline, so the camera leads.
lead_frac.title: Lead Frac

follow_window.description: Share of the timeline treated as 'recent' when framing.
follow_window.title: Follow Window

follow_smoothing.description: Share of the gap to the action closed every 1/30 s: low = smooth but laggy, 1 = snaps to it. Independent of fps.
follow_smoothing.title: Follow Smoothing

fit_padding.description: Padding in pixels around the action.
fit_padding.title: Fit Padding

CinematicCamera.title: Cinematic fly-through

FixedCamera.description: One view for the whole clip: by default the whole scene, at the map's tilt and heading.

lon.description: Center longitude. Leave blank for the center of the data.
lon.title: Lon

lat.description: Center latitude. Leave blank for the center of the data.
lat.title: Lat

range.description: Camera distance from the center in metres. Leave blank to fit the data in the frame.
range.title: Range (m)

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees (0 = straight down). Leave blank for the map's.
tilt.title: Tilt

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees. Leave blank for the map's.
heading.title: Heading

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

FixedCamera.title: Fixed view

FlyAroundCamera.description:
Fly to a point, then circle it -- the Google Maps 3D flyCameraTo + flyCameraAround pair.

The fly-to follows deck's FlyToInterpolator arc (out, across and back in) from the whole-scene
view; the orbit then turns at a constant rate for `rounds` turns.

lon.description: Center longitude. Leave blank for the center of the data.
lon.title: Lon

lat.description: Center latitude. Leave blank for the center of the data.
lat.title: Lat

range.description: Camera distance from the center in metres. Leave blank to fit the data in the frame.
range.title: Range (m)

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees (0 = straight down). Leave blank for the map's.
tilt.title: Tilt

heading.description: Compass heading on arrival. Leave blank for the map's.
heading.title: Heading

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

fly_frac.description: Share of the clip spent flying in from the whole-scene view. 0 = start at the center.
fly_frac.title: Fly Frac

rounds.description: Full turns around the center after arriving. 0 = hold.
rounds.title: Rounds

FlyAroundCamera.title: Fly to & around

FollowActionCamera.description:
Keeps the moving subjects in frame: frames what animated in the last `follow_window` of the
timeline, re-fitting smoothly as they move and spread.

subjects.description: Only frame these subjects (their value in any column, e.g. names), zooming out as they spread apart. Leave blank for everything that animates.
subjects.title: Subjects

tilt.description: Tilt in degrees (0 = straight down). Leave blank for the map's.
tilt.title: Tilt

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees. Leave blank for the map's.
heading.title: Heading

face_travel.description: Turn the camera to face the direction of travel.
face_travel.title: Face Travel

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

lead_room.description: Space left ahead of moving subjects, as a share of the view: the camera looks a little ahead, so they sit behind the centre with room to move into. 0 = centred.
lead_room.title: Lead room

speed_zoom.description: Zoom in (up to a level) while subjects rest or move slowly, and pull back while they travel fast. 0 = off, 1 = strongest.
speed_zoom.title: Zoom with the action

keep_in_view.description: Raise the camera when a ridge would hide what it follows, easing back down after it.
keep_in_view.title: Keep in view over hills

follow_window.description: Share of the timeline treated as 'recent' when framing.
follow_window.title: Follow Window

follow_smoothing.description: Share of the gap to the action closed every 1/30 s: low = smooth but laggy, 1 = snaps to it. Independent of fps.
follow_smoothing.title: Follow Smoothing

fit_padding.description: Padding in pixels around the action.
fit_padding.title: Fit Padding

FollowActionCamera.title: Follow the action

FollowSubjectCamera.description:
Stays behind one subject at a set distance (range) and tilt, facing where it is going next. Its path
and turns are smoothed both ways in time, so the subject stays in the middle of the frame.

subject.description: Value identifying the subject in any column (e.g. its name or group id). Leave blank for the longest-running track.
subject.title: Subject

range.description: Camera distance from the subject in metres. Around 100 m shows a 3D animal at its real size; raise it to see more of the land around it.
range.title: Range (m)

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees. Leave blank to face the subject's direction of travel.
heading.title: Heading

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

lead_room.description: Space left ahead of moving subjects, as a share of the view: the camera looks a little ahead, so they sit behind the centre with room to move into. 0 = centred.
lead_room.title: Lead room

speed_zoom.description: Zoom in (up to a level) while subjects rest or move slowly, and pull back while they travel fast. 0 = off, 1 = strongest.
speed_zoom.title: Zoom with the action

keep_in_view.description: Raise the camera when a ridge would hide what it follows, easing back down after it.
keep_in_view.title: Keep in view over hills

follow_smoothing.description: How closely the camera keeps to the subject's every move: low = smooths over its zigzags (up to a second of video either side), 1 = locked on.
follow_smoothing.title: Follow Smoothing

turn_smoothing.description: How quickly the camera turns to stay behind the subject: low = slow, sweeping turns (up to two seconds of video), 1 = turns at once.
turn_smoothing.title: Turn Smoothing

FollowSubjectCamera.title: Follow a subject

KeyframesCamera.description:
Flies through waypoints while the data animates: add views in the Camera panel, upload a
waypoint file, or follow a subject.

Waypoints given in ``keyframes`` take priority over ``source``. Waypoints without a zoom use
the whole-scene framing.

keyframes.description: Camera waypoints, flown through in order. Each needs lon/lat; t (0–1 clip position), zoom, pitch and bearing are optional. Leave empty to build the path from Source instead.
keyframes.title: Keyframes

source.description: How to build the path when `keyframes` is empty: upload a file, or follow a subject.
source.title: Source

keyframe_easing.description: How the camera moves between keyframes: 'smooth' eases in/out of each waypoint, 'linear' moves at constant speed, 'spline' curves through waypoints (Catmull-Rom) without pausing at them.
keyframe_easing.title: Keyframe Easing

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

KeyframesCamera.title: Keyframes

KeyframesFromFile.description: Camera path loaded from an uploaded waypoint file.

keyframes_file.description: Path to an uploaded keyframe file: a .json list of {lon, lat, t?, zoom?, pitch?, bearing?} objects, a .geojson of Point features (extras read from properties), or a .csv/.tsv with lon/lat columns. Required for this source.
keyframes_file.title: Keyframes File

KeyframesFromFile.title: Upload waypoint file

KeyframesFromSubject.description:
Camera path auto-derived by following one subject through the animated data.

The subject is matched against every column, so it works for trips and for point or
polygon layers that carry the subject's column.

subject.description: Value identifying the subject in any column (e.g. its name or group id). Leave blank to follow the longest-running track.
subject.title: Subject

KeyframesFromSubject.title: Follow a subject

SubjectTourCamera.description:
Follows each subject in turn for an equal share of the clip, from behind at a set distance (range)
and tilt, flying from one to the next, with a name card as each one comes in.

subjects.description: Subjects to visit, in this order (their value in any column, e.g. names). Leave blank for every subject, in name order.
subjects.title: Subjects

range.description: Camera distance from the subject in metres. Around 100 m shows a 3D animal at its real size; raise it to see more of the land around it.
range.title: Range (m)

heading.description: Compass heading in degrees. Leave blank to face each subject's direction of travel.
heading.title: Heading

fov.description: Vertical lens angle: wider is a wide-angle look, narrower a telephoto one. Leave blank for the map's (about 37°).
fov.title: Field of view (°)

name_cards.description: Show each subject's name for a few seconds as the camera reaches it.
name_cards.title: Name Cards

transition_frac.description: Share of each subject's turn spent flying over from the previous one.
transition_frac.title: Fly between

lead_room.description: Space left ahead of moving subjects, as a share of the view: the camera looks a little ahead, so they sit behind the centre with room to move into. 0 = centred.
lead_room.title: Lead room

speed_zoom.description: Zoom in (up to a level) while subjects rest or move slowly, and pull back while they travel fast. 0 = off, 1 = strongest.
speed_zoom.title: Zoom with the action

keep_in_view.description: Raise the camera when a ridge would hide what it follows, easing back down after it.
keep_in_view.title: Keep in view over hills

follow_smoothing.description: How closely the camera keeps to the subject's every move: low = smooths over its zigzags (up to a second of video either side), 1 = locked on.
follow_smoothing.title: Follow Smoothing

turn_smoothing.description: How quickly the camera turns to stay behind the subject: low = slow, sweeping turns (up to two seconds of video), 1 = turns at once.
turn_smoothing.title: Turn Smoothing

SubjectTourCamera.title: Subject tour
